Main
================================================================================

John Zobolas {#title}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

<p style="text-align:justify; background-color:#e1d8f0; border-radius: 5px; padding: 20px;">
My background is in computer science, with diverse expertise in computational modeling, software engineering, survival analysis and statistical/machine learning.
Being <b>an engineer at heart</b>, my strongest quality is careful, analytical thinking.
I am deeply committed to <b>open-source software</b> and actively contribute to the R ecosystem as a core member of <a href="https://mlr-org.com/">mlr3</a>.
I am currently the maintainer of <a href="http://github.com/mlr-org/mlr3proba">mlr3proba</a> and additional CRAN packages, including 
<a href="https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/CoxBoost/index.html">CoxBoost</a> and 
<a href="https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/fastVoteR/index.html">fastVoteR</a>.
</p>
